calculation_or_explanation: All 117 real REE nodes. One row per node. Three existing MCA scenarios plus clustering context. Scores recomputed and reconciled against saved results.
Static calculated values, not a live spreadsheet. Blank numeric cells mean missing or unranked, never zero. Formulas are explained in this companion dictionary.

Inputs: results/real/tables/nodes_integrated.csv. Scenarios: config/scoring.yaml and src/bess_catalonia/scoring/model.py. Clustering: config/clustering.yaml, src/bess_catalonia/ml/clustering.py and saved clustering_assignments.csv.
Weights are illustrative project placeholders. No new weights or opportunity classifications were invented.
Protected-area conflict excludes ranking in every scenario. Coverage below 0.5 excludes ranking. Flood flag is context, not a direct current scoring exclusion. Normalisation includes excluded nodes.

ERNI is absent for all nodes. Its weight is removed: included scenario weights are 0.65 renewable absorption, 0.90 connection readiness and 0.85 load/grid support when other inputs are present. No observed congestion is inferred.
For a complete connection-readiness row except ERNI: score = ROUND((0.40*normalised_headroom + 0.30*normalised_land_5km + 0.20*normalised_road_distance)/0.90, 6).

Ward hierarchical clustering on seven log-transformed and standardised features. A unconstrained; B six geographic neighbours; C approximate OSM/PyPSA-Eur adjacency plus geographic fallback. Clustering does not enter scenario scores.
This export uses the current saved repository inputs. Export creation date is not a measurement or source publication date. Input rows do not contain a common observation date.
